text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: The sound... of a construction site...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Some might find it noisy, but... I don't 
dislike this sound.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(A rhythmic, steady cadence echoing... 
Someone is hard at work today, too. Giving 
their all to craft something great...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...? Wait, looking closer... no one's 
actually working...?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Could this be... not the sound of 
construction... but a headache?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Believe was plagued by a headache 
for some time afterward."
